  - scheduler: `include/catlass/gemm/block/block_swizzle.hpp`
  - reduce: `include/catlass/gemm/kernel/splitk_matmul.hpp`

Key techniques:

- Live path is mix fp32 MultiCoreSplitkMatmulTla. AIC writes splitkFactor full M×N accumulator planes; AIV SplitkReduceAdd owns GM C. Cube Block is 43 pingpong.
  - evidence `source-code` `examples/68_ascend950_multi_core_splitk_matmul/multi_core_splitk_matmul.cpp`
  - evidence `source-code` `examples/68_ascend950_multi_core_splitk_matmul/CMakeLists.txt` — catlass_example_add_executable mix
  - evidence `source-code` `include/catlass/gemm/kernel/multi_core_splitk_matmul_tla.hpp`
  - evidence `source-code` `include/catlass/gemm/kernel/splitk_matmul.hpp` — SplitkReduceAdd only; SplitkMatmul kernel class is not live
- GetSplitkFactor starts at 2; if aicCoreNum/blockNum > 0 it becomes that quotient (can be 1); then min with kTileNum. Cap by kTileNum means not every AIC is guaranteed work.
  - evidence `source-code` `include/catlass/gemm/kernel/multi_core_splitk_matmul_tla.hpp` — GetSplitkFactor
- Suggested when CeilDiv(M,m1)*CeilDiv(N,n1) <= C/2.
  - evidence `design-doc` `examples/68_ascend950_multi_core_splitk_matmul/README.md`
  - not: Documented heuristic, not a benchmark sweep. Binary always SplitKs.
- Upstream optest covers this example (fp32 256x512x1024).
  - evidence `test` `tests/optest/tests/test_68_ascend950_multi_core_splitk_matmul.py`
  - not: JIT TileShapeScalerTLA shrinks fp32 L1-K to 64; shipped example keeps 128.
